script_text: Something volatile ignites across your charts this week, Aries. Mid-week, the Sun conjunct your natal Ascendant in the 1st sparks the key turning point. By Thursday, Venus sextile Jupiter in your 7th boosts collaboration, while Saturday’s opposition from Pluto in the 2nd shifts finances. Monday is your power day because Mars applies a supportive sextile to your 5th, fueling love and creativity, whereas Tuesday challenges career focus. Take bold action to align your words with your values. Follow for daily updates.
